hypothesis: Conditioning H3-WAM on the 16 actions actually executed before each replan reduces leak-free generated-action error and creates more goal-directed LIBERO contact than the cold-start step5000 parent.
single_variable: Expose the 16 real actions immediately preceding each dense window as fixed clean history tokens, exclude them from action loss, and feed the last 16 executed environment actions through the same slots at deployment; all target data, weights, optimizer, sampler and rollout protocol remain fixed.
parent_baseline: quantile_flowweight_lr1e5_tail2_s10000_step005000.pt; causal val40 video/action 0.259440/0.719067; fixed Goal task3 trial0 replan16 success 0/1 with max object delta 1.45e-16.

references.title: LingBot-VA: Causal World Modeling for Robot Control

architecture.upstream_code: after execution, client sends actions and observations to server; server updates action/video KV cache
architecture.local: 16 executed actions are explicit fixed clean tokens on every replan; no persistent transformer KV yet
architecture.rationale: Explicit clean-history tokens preserve the upstream information flow while H3 packed attention is recomputed instead of caching K/V.

data.upstream_code: dataset prepends the action history frame and deployment feeds executed state
data.local: per-episode sidecars provide exactly actions[max(0,start-16):start], left-zero-padded only at episode start
data.rationale: No future action enters the history prefix; existing 200779 dense windows and episode-disjoint split are unchanged.

action.upstream_code: q01/q99 normalized action frames; executed action feedback
action.local: same locked q01/q99 transform; first16 tokens observed and omitted from returned next32 actions
action.rationale: Training and deployment share the same raw-environment-action to normalized-history boundary.

objective.upstream_code: action mask gates action flow loss
objective.local: weighted action flow loss is computed only over the 32 target tokens; history is fixed clean conditioning
objective.rationale: Past executed actions cannot contribute a trivial reconstruction loss.

optimization.upstream_code: 5000 optimizer steps at effective global batch80
optimization.local: 100 steps, global batch8, 800 sampled windows, LR1e-5, WD0.01, tail2, parent step5000
optimization.rationale: This is a mechanism canary. A separate dossier is required before any 3000-step continuation.

evaluation.local: paired causal val40 then fixed Goal task3/trial0/replan16; long training requires >=2% action improvement, <=2% video regression and real object contact
evaluation.rationale: The fixed parent protocol isolates the history mechanism before full benchmark spending.
